blocks.text: Kai endocrine glands master gland, yaani pituitary, ke qaboo mein hain, magar pituitary khud dimagh ke aik hisse, hypothalamus, ke qaboo mein hai. Hypothalamus mein neurosecretory cells hain jo nerve impulses bhi le jate aur hormones bhi chhorte hain.

items: Posterior pituitary ka qaboo: oxytocin aur ADH hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells banate hain; un ke axons hormones ko posterior pituitary tak le jate hain jahan woh khoon mein chhorne ke liye jama rehte hain.

Anterior pituitary ka qaboo: khoon ki nalyan hypothalamus ko anterior pituitary se jorti hain. Neurosecretory cells aise hormones chhorte hain jo in nalyon se guzarte hain: releasing hormones anterior pituitary se us ke hormones banwate aur chhurwate hain, aur inhibiting hormones use rokte hain.

blocks.alt: Hypothalamus aur pituitary ki tarash. Hypothalamus mein neurosecretory cells (narangi sitare) hain. Zyada tar ke axons danthal (stalk) se neeche posterior pituitary mein jate hain; chand ke axons danthal ke oopar capillaries ke jaal par khatam hote hain. Aik artery is jaal aur anterior pituitary ko khoon deti hai; aik portal nali danthal ki capillaries se anterior pituitary ki capillaries tak jati hai. Doosri artery posterior pituitary mein aati hai; dono lobes ki veins neeche mil jati hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khaake ko do raston mein parhein. Daen rasta (posterior pituitary): hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells khud oxytocin aur ADH banate hain aur yeh hormones lambe axons (nerve ke dhaagon) ke andar neeche posterior lobe tak pohanchte hain; wahan yeh jama rehte hain aur zaroorat par khoon (vein) mein chhoot'te hain. Baen rasta (anterior pituitary): chhote axons wale cells apne releasing ya inhibiting hormones danthal ke oopar capillaries mein dalte hain; wahan se portal nali (neeli) yeh hormones seedha anterior pituitary ki capillaries tak le jati hai. Is tarah anterior pituitary nerve se nahi balke khoon ki nali se qaboo hota hai.

blocks.caption: Hypothalamus ke hormones aur anterior pituitary par asar

blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke cells jo nerve impulses bhi le jate aur hormones bhi chhorte hain, jaise oxytocin, ADH aur releasing aur inhibiting hormones.

items: Hypothalamus pituitary ko qaboo karta: axons posterior lobe tak (oxytocin, ADH); releasing aur inhibiting hormones khoon ki nalyon se anterior lobe tak.
